notes.title: New Content: "Iron Royale" Open Test Notice
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/07fc613cb5e77767d63c63b7fda880063a230f1d.png[/img]
Greetings to all! This is GM Pong.


The new "Iron Royal" game mode will be released for an Open Test in patch 3.4.0 next week.

"Iron Royal (Temporary)" is a game mode that combines the Battle Royale system(which has recently become a popular game genre) and Iron League MOBA system. It is a way to keep the fun of the battle and play the game in a shorter time.

A square ring of death narrows over time, within which you would have to fight individually or as a team to become the survivor(s) and obtain victory.

You can freely use the runes, skills and items based on the Iron League system. You can improve your items within the game with the gold acquired by killing or having assistance on your team. Using the Auto-purchase item system in the options menu, you will have more time to concentrate on the victory.
The Solo, Duo and Trio modes will be available and you can enjoy a variety of fun games with different combinations and strategies.

We hope you enjoy the "Iron Royal" Mode, a different mode from the existing Battle Royale, through the open test next week.

Thank you so much!

* More information will be announced in Patch Note 3.4.0.
* Iron Royal mode can be selected from the existing PLAY button. Solo, Duo and Trio modes are rotated to test efficiency and will be activated one by one.
* The schedule of the open test may be subject to change.
* Your diverse and sincere opinions will be of great help to improve Iron League.

Iron Royale Play video

https://youtu.be/pJrwIHXvJ9c

notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is developer D.

There are some changes and improvements in 2.9.0 version. Please check the specifics below. 

1. Change in unit and value of In-game Currency
: Amount of currency for every item and reward is adjusted as the unit and 
   value of in-game currency have been changed.

: Price of every item, including diamonds, is adjusted, as well as mission 
   rewards, game play rewards, and every consumption/receipt of wealth. 

*Owned wealth will be adjusted according to the changed value.


A change in price of items will look like this:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/40291df0811f95a9deba2304c15be05198463d37.png[/img]

The unit of currency is decreased and some items’ value is slightly adjusted. 

We know this is a huge change, so please give yourself a time to get used to the change.
(In fact, there are some parts where you can get more golds/diamonds than before. It’s a secret!)


2. Praise UI Improvement
: We have improved the praise page in which you couldn’t easily separate each team before.
: You could only separate each team by looking at their nicknames before then, but now you can visually separate each team with different color.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/5f813affe778289ab221cbcc0e82c21f2e55e255.png[/img]


3. Improvements
1) Changing the location of Lucky Roulette
: Lucky Roulette is moved to the event page. You can check it out by clicking 
  a ‘gift box’ icon on the top left corner of the lobby. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/eaea1da8a3dbc2c18e6de72d62d4f8c27614786b.png[/img]

2)  Spell Selection UI Improvement
: Name of spell is shown below the spell icon in the spell selection page. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/48b64070bbd2909bb3b0857c7d9638dde557afc0.png[/img]

3) In-game UI size adjustment option improvement
: Minimum/Maximum value of UI size adjustment is improved.

4) Acquisition of Mastery point improvement and change in level of receiving skin
: Amount of Mastery point you can receive is massively increased and now you can acquire chroma skin in level 3, not in level 4.



4. Balance Adjustment of Ironsides
: Balance of Ironsides below is adjusted.

1) Alexander
[Power Smash]
Cooldown Time (sec) : 9/9/9/7 -> 10/10/10/8

[Shoulder Attack]
Cooldown Time (sec) : 8 -> 9

[Scrum]
Restraint Time (sec) : 2.5/3/3.5/3.5 -> 2/2.5/3/3

 2) Kampe

Skill Damage : 50/150/250/350(+180%) -> 50/125/200/300(+150)

3) Mamon
[Death from the Dark]
Skill Damage : 100/150/200(+150%)300(+200%) -> 50/75/100/200(+200%)

4) Thanatos
[Default Stats]
Movement Speed : 3.6 -> 3.4

5) Ax
[Execution]
Skill Damage : 0/50/100(+230%)/100(+280%) -> 0/50/100(+200%)/100(+250%)

[Chastisement]
Skill Damage : 0/75/150/150(+215%) -> 0/75/150/150(+200%)

6) Pong
[Raging Twister]
Cooldown Time (sec) : 40 -> 35
Skill Damage : 150/250/350/450(+150%) -> 150/250/350/450(+100%)

7) Caren
[EMP Beam]
Cooldown Time (sec) : 10 -> 9
[Superelectron]
Cooldown Time (sec) : 45 -> 40

8) Alpha 
[Ultra V Slash]
Cooldown Time (sec) : 45 -> 40

9) Draga
[Let’s Play Ball!]
Cooldown Time (sec) : 15 -> 12


5. Season Reset
: Season 4 ends on January 7th, 2019 (Seoul/Tokyo Time). New season begins on the same date, January 7th, 2019 (Seoul/Tokyo Time), and our next season reward skin is for Alpha!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/6b59c351c2aec6e2e040d121416d8721c6e4e0f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer's Note: Sneak-peek to the 2.5 Patch
notes.content:
Hello, Leaguers! This is GM XiangYu.
Here I bring to you (finally!) our next developer's notes for our upcoming patches. Let's take a look!
==========================================================================

[h1][b]2.5.0 Developer's Note[/b][/h1]

Our upcoming updates focused on two points: Improving our in-game convenience and hero/combat item balances. We have a long way to go, and more specific details will be discussed in our patch note.

[h1]1. Redesign of Achievements: Daily Missions[/h1]
Our biggest changes here is the redesign of the Achievement panel. The original achievements of the Iron League were the types that would rather fit well into the RPG game rather than the MOBA genre. Not only they were tedious to acquire but also its reward was too low and unsatisfying. So we got rid of all those achievements and implemented new Daily Missions! Those who were working hard for the original Achievements will be rewarded for their effort.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/1de20c2e72b491eb6772da2bcb2036de5a6f0de1.png[/img]

As the title shows, there will be four daily missions that will change day by day. Before you go right into the game, please check your missions so that you can play accordingly and get the rewards for completing them!


[h1]2. Ironsides Price Adjustment[/h1]
Next, we adjusted some ironsides' prices. We have received tons of feedback from the users about the pricing of our game, and now it is the time to take action.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/9c6e8352e42434bf171b1a6b8219f12e9a174c4f.png[/img]

We will apply the new prices to these Ironsides with our 2.5.0 patch. For those planning to buy them, we strongly recommend you to make your purchase AFTER the patch.


[h1]3. Replay Improved[/h1]
Replay is where new users can learn other's moves and old users be proud of one's own gameplay. The replays of the Iron League was somewhat inconvenient and only showed limited information of the game. So we have made it more convenient and knowledgeable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/73794e4fcab57b6d9aff97b349e1c234c6afcc57.png[/img]

[b]1) Ironside/Target Panel[/b]
When you click the Ironside, the panel will show his/her skill levels, cooldown time, spells, HP, and stats. When you click minions or objects, the panel will show its HP and stats only.

[b]2) Ironside Info Panel[/b]
You can check the Ironsides' stat panel. These stats will be updated real-time as the game progresses. Turn on/off this panel by clicking the arrow next to the portrait.

[b]3) Timeline[/b]
The replay timeline has been divided for each team. If the Ironside is killed, it will be displayed in red/blue line. If the object is destroyed, it will be displayed as icons.

[b]4) Scoreboard[/b]
The scoreboard will show the gold acquired by EACH Ironside.


[h1]4. Observer(Spectator) system added in Competition Mode[/h1]
Thanks to our user's suggestion, we enabled the main manager of the Competition game to invite multiple observers. Enjoy the tournament with a bigger audience!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/b8552fe801b7fd3de78ecc03158d2e1cdb999733.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/4057a12e218e56d48eb6a3e3b200c45041747f31.png[/img]

[b]1) Invite players[/b]
As usual, you can invite users who will play the Competition Mode. This is separated from observer invitation.

[b]2) Invite observers[/b]
You can invite users as "observers" (with the invitation icon that looks like an eye). Maximum 6 observers can enter the game. 

[b]3) How to switch players and observers[/b]
Only the main manager of the Competition game can switch players and observers. Observers can become players freely. In contrast, players can only be "exchanged" to observers. If there are no observers, players have to get out of the room and be invited as observers.

[b]4) How to switch teams[/b]
The original team switch system remains. Additionally, the main manager can switch the players' team by drag&drop on the player's list.

[b]5) Observer list[/b]
You can open/close the observer list by clicking the "Observer List" button at the center.

[b]6) Observers also can post the replay of the game.[/b]

※Attention: If you are invited as the observer of a game, you cannot start your own match until that game ends.


[h1]5. Ironside/Combat item Rebalance[/h1]
Before we start with this topic, we will briefly explain by what standard will the characters and items be balanced. Our main focus of balancing work is
[olist]
[*][b]to enhance the supporter class Ironsides[/b],
[*][b]to modify stats and skills to strengthen each Ironside's unique aspects[/b]
[*][b]to let the Ironsides make synergy even within the same class role.[/b]
[/olist]
Based on these principles, this time we concentrated on modifying some stats and skills for the overpowered and the weak Ironsides.

Please be aware that the balancing work is constantly in progress and the stat adjustments displayed below may also change again. When they do so, we will notify you further with additional notes.

[b]Rebalanced Ironsides:[/b]
Alpha, Pong, Baku, Alexander, Kampe


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/f37283b0faf4c51f05633298a994874533ac9cea.png[/img]
[b]Alpha[/b]
Alpha was too versatile, strong in both attack and defense. The boomerang had a too good attack stat buff and its damage was overly powerful. More than that, his passive skill lasted so long (1 minute!) that Alpha could stay on his battlefield with much less healing items. So we nerfed him, simply speaking.
[list]
[*]Power-up(Passive): Every stat bonus from the passive has decreased except the defense.
- Attack +30, Attack speed +0.3, Defense +20, Movement Speed +0.3, HP regen +3 / Passive skill's cooldown time decreases by 1 second for every basic attack.
=> Attack +20, Attack speed +0.2, Defense +20, Movement speed +0.3, HP regen +2 / Passive skill's cooldown time decreases by 0.5 second for every basic attack.

[*]Super Boomerang(Q skill): Attack bonus of the boomerang decreased. Don't be obsessed with holding it!
- Attack bonus: 25/35/45/50 => 10/20/30/40

[*]Lightning Kick(W skill): Alpha's knee kick was fast and stunning, just like lightning. Now, the skill's stun effect duration decreased.
- Stun duration: 1 => 0.75 sec.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/15bb92e6e1f26e7e462551f40b16783caeb91f0a.png[/img]
[b]Pong[/b]
We expected cute Pong to show his prowess with his useful crowd control skills. However, his pick&win rates were both low. It is time for the curious beastkin to show his talent!
[list]
[*]Wind Elixir(Q skill): The elixir becomes lighter and is fermented a lot faster, but its healing effect decreases a little bit.
- Cooldown time: 10 => 7 sec.
- HP healed: 100/150/200/250 => 50/75/100/125
- Elixir duration: 30/30/30/35 => 25 sec.
- Time for fermentation: 15 => 5 sec.

[*]Sweeping Tornado(W skill): Looks like Pong's fan got bigger! The wind's damage increased.
- Damage: 25/75/125/175(80%) => 75/125/175/225(100%)

[*]Raging Twister(E skill): The wind's damage increased. However, the enemies airborne will fall faster.
- Damage: 0/100/200/300 (140%) => 150/250/350/450 (150%)
Airborne duration: 1.3/1.3/1.3/1.5 => 1/1/1/1.3 sec.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/55f813ebdc22961c40b5af57ba888ba064a906c5.png[/img]
[b]Baku[/b]
Baku's pick&win rate was not very high in contrast to his strong appearance. Back from his training, the Sankrinian martial artist has mastered his skills to higher level.
[list]
[*]The Deranged Wolf(Passive): We fixed an error with the damage stat bonus.
- Per 100 damage received, next skill damage +20% => 10

[*]Wave Attack: Baku can use his wave attack more frequently. The skill cooldown decreased.
- Cooldown time: 10 => 8 sec.

[*]Overwhelming: Baku can suppress his opponents more frequently. The skill cooldown decreased.
- Cooldown time: 60 => 50 sec.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/fbabaa57308762e6e6d48231c96e89fa79f41c39.png[/img]
[b]Alexander[/b]
Although Alexander showed up a lot in games, his win rate among the uppe- rank users was relatively low. We enhanced one of his ability so that he could be a better Ironside for top-tier Leaguers.
[list]
[*]Power smash
Area of effect increased
- Basic damage stat added: 0(40/60/80/100%) => 30/50/70/100(20/40/60/80)
- Skill effect added: When activated, Alexander's movement speed increases by 0.5/1/1.5/2
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/873fc4051e5216cf6972bf377c6406465eacd897.png[/img]
[b]Kampe[/b]
Although he was a competent general, Kampe also suffered from his low pick&win rate. Now he has come back as a seasoned warrior with a devastating firepower.
[list]
[*]Expertise(Passive): Based on his experience, Kampe can spot the enemy's weak spot easier. His defense penetration effect increased.
- Def. Penetration: Character Level*2 => Level*3

[*]Vulcan Punch(W skill): Kampe restructured his handcannon. The area of effect increased.

[*]Barrage(E skill): Kampe also enlarged his ballistic cannonball. It became easier for him to target his prey.
[/list]

[b]Rebalanced Combat Items:[/b]
Curse of Blood, Shape of Madness

To help the range dealers to deal with tankers and bruisers, we increased the Defense Penetration stat for both items.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/c1bdc85b55c146a04da6e157922f3b8a468f3ca8.png[/img]
Curse of Blood
- Def. Penetration: 3/7/12/18/25 => 8/12/17/23/30

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/ee8bc354da2156373dd60427a02c9295c78a1355.png[/img]
Shape of Madness
- Def. Penetration: 7/14/21/28/35% => 8/16/24/32/40%


[b]Stat upper limit established[/b]
Until now the HP drain was very, and sometimes overly, effective in battle. This was because there was no upper ceiling for stats.

Now, the HP drain's upper limit is set so that users may have to choose different runes and items for survival.
- HP drain's upper limit: 50%


==========================================================================

Thank you for reading so far. We have much more to tell you, but we had to briefly introduce the change in our upcoming patch. For more update details, please check our patch notes. And if there is any change in our balancing, we will notify them.

See you all in our 2.5 updates!

notes.title: Developer's Note: Global Server and AI
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/37560848ada830fe4c32ed63772e7fd6528d0197.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/892dfdd008e84bb21e20bb5fceeaba70830cbe76.png[/img][/url]

Greetings to all! This is GM XiangYu, the Herald of the League. I am here to directly deliver the words from our developers.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

We, the devs of the Dexintgames, have been persevering to find an answer to one of the most essential questions since our server merge:

[b]How can we let users play a fair match in a stable network condition?[/b]

As you all do, we ourselves have some experiences of missing our skills that would have definitely hit due to harsh lag, or unnecessarily being killed by opponents because of it. Simply saying, it is not a pleasant memory indeed. And we understand that you are angry and frustrated since there hasn't been a word from us about how our global server works.

With our recent 2.4 patch, the Iron League has changed a lot once more. We decided that this would be a right moment to tell users about our game's matching mechanism.


[h1][b]Merging many to one: A path to a global server and its specifics[/b][/h1]

A few months ago, we have merged our separate regional servers to one so that more users can play games with each other. We have also expected that through this server consolidation, we might be able to (at least partially) resolve our AI bot issues that numberless users have been complaining about.

Originally there were four regional servers that we were running:
[list]
[*]Northeast Asia
[*]Southeast Asia
[*]North America
[*]Europe
[/list]
And as our server consolidation patch, we gave to our game 3 major changes.
[olist]
[*][b]Establishment of a new server: South America[/b]
We have received from our South American users numerous requests to open their own regional servers. We have accepted their requests and opened up our South American gameplay server.

[*][b]All region's "Lobby Server" merged into one.[/b]
Every regional server of the Iron League is composed of two parts: the "Lobby" server where users chat, make friends, and go to the market to buy goods, and the "Gameplay" server where you are matched with others and play games. The "server merge" that we have done was the process of converging all regional servers' lobbies to one. In other words, the gameplay servers are still separated according to regions, and our ultimate objective of the global server patch was to connect these 5 gameplay servers.

[*][b]"Webbing" the regions[/b]
Establishing a web of a network among the 5 regions around the globe was certainly not an easy task. We have spent a lot of time and effort in this matter. The basic principle that we brought out is this:
we allocate our users into the regional server that provides the most optimal gameplay environment.
[list]
[*][b]Rule A[/b]: When the users of the same regional server are matched, they are allocated to the server of that region.
[*][b]Rule B[/b]: When the users of different regional servers are matched, they are allocated to the server depending on the number of people in that party. For example, when there are 2 American users and 4 Brazilian users in one game, they will all play the game in the South American server.
[*][b]Rule C[/b]: When there is the same number of people from each regional server, they are allocated to the server of the user who has started the match queue the earliest.
[/list]
※Beware: These 3 rules equally apply with/without AI bots in the party. The AIs are not allocated a specific regional server.
[/olist]


Of course, we are still experiencing some difficulties to provide users most suitable conditions for gameplay. The initial network instability between the regions far far away was somewhat inevitable. Imagine the situation in which you are the only Korean in a game and the other 5 users are Southeast Asians. Or imagine that you are a Brazillian and you party up with your friend in Europe server.

Our current goal is to stabilize this global web to much higher level and we are constantly working on it. Thankfully, our global lobby server's stability has actually been improved due to packet minimalization and optimization.


[h1][b]Inside View: What about AI?[/b][/h1]

Aside from our work on the global network and further development of gameplay contents, we are obliged to talk about our AI problems here. The devs are now experimenting with how to utilize them instead of contemplating to get rid of them instantly.

As mentioned far above, we expected that converging our user pool would naturally let us decrease the number of AI. But the recent statistics displayed that the situation did not get much better.

We know you all hate them. We always hear you say "Kick out the bots or I'll quit!!" But we will be honest here. If we do eliminate AIs, our matching time will certainly be longer due to our thin playerbase. And this would dissatisfy another type of users, those who want to play games no matter who they fight with.

We decided that instead of annihilating the bots right now, it would be better in the short term to inform the users the possibility of matching against bots and establishing a fair&fun gameplay environment even with the bots included. But we've been gradually decreasing the number of bots, and we promise you that it will decrease more and more in the long term.

Thank you for reading this long note. Every single moment we genuinely appreciate your support.

notes.title: 2.4 Update: Developer's Note
notes.content:
Hello, Leaguers! This is GM XiangYu, the Herald of the League.
I am here to give you a sneak peek at our upcoming major update. This time, we focused more on "systematical improvement" rather than the "addition of new contents." Here we go!

======================================================

[h1][b]1. Minimap HUD option added[/b][/h1]
In our last patch, we have moved the in-game minimap to the left side of the screen. It seems that this gave confusion to many Leaguers who were already accustomed to the original UI. So, we have added an option that changes the position of the minimap. The default location would be the upper righthand corner, and you can change it in the option panel.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/ddc02fdb370a698c3faf01c4f69e33faf8e64f61.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/921c1a4d83f4967e3e78058e14d922f28a9c446e.png[/img]

Moreover, you can adjust the size of the minimap. Even if you shrank your UI size, you can expand the size of the minimap separately.


[h1][b]2. Ironsides info panel improved[/b][/h1]
Since Iron League is a MOBA game, the display of characters' information is one of its most essential aspects. We have changed the structure of our ironside intro screen so that you can check their infos more intuitively.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/f7e530b3248ed5b409c24352123ae46e41845a5e.png[/img]

The ironside will be positioned in the center of the screen so that you can focus on its appearance first, and you can scroll up&down the skin info.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/c0d62c16816f14c3a821d46e620d5c01d31f22dd.png[/img]

Also, you can easily check the ironside's overall stats and their changes when your runepages are applied. Don't forget to check how much stronger your character can get when you equip your runes!


[h1][b]3. Ironside pick panel improved[/b][/h1]
The original pick panel for the ironsides was... untidy, so to speak. It was uncategorized and therefore hard to find the character. In this patch, we have finally sorted our characters according to their class roles. You can pick the ironside you want very conveniently.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/4e30f6b6544c973b752a7c790aae79e378922d5b.png[/img]


[h1][b]4. In-game ping(network) improved[/b][/h1]
As we have merged our regional servers, the initial phase of our global service was somewhat unstable and chaotic. There were some difficulties in matching the Leaguers from all around the world without any disturbances. 

However, we are currently undertaking a process to let users play our game in the optimal network connection based on their regions. This "connectivity improvement" is still ongoing, and your active feedback related to this issue will always be a great help to our work.

====================================================

These are the major branches of our next patch. For the specifics and details, please check the official patch note that we upload this week.

The League has just started its 3rd season. This is our first season where users are starting with a global server and the Council is truly looking forward to how it proceeds. Thank you for reading, and the League always thanks you all for your passion and support.

Hello, Leaguers! This is GM XiangYu, the Herald of the League.

[h1]#From the devs: what changes[/h1]
[b]1. Rank "Bronze IV" & "Silver IV" deleted![/b]

- In the previous season, we figured out that our most prominent users started their rank game in already high tiers so that they lost what to do after they reached the top. So in this season, we will lower the starting line of our best leaguers and incentivize them to compete with each other.

notes.title: Attention: A Guide for Account Synchronization
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/69af8a995bb9305e19a132d65b4bd0822a38edb2.png[/img]

Greetings to all Leaguers! This is GM XiangYu.

In the upcoming 2.3 update, the new feature that you all yearned for
will be finally added: account synchronization! Now you can link your accounts between/among different platforms and unite them.

Let's have a closer look at this whole process.
It's not a rocket science, so no need to worry.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/abb6667171b5995b0e3f12ecdb78e754f5e8005c.png[/img]

1. Please turn on the Iron League on the platform that you wish to EXPORT the account info (Platform A) and the platform that you wish to IMPORT the account info (Platform B). If you don't have the Iron League account on the importing platform, please make one so that you can import.

2. When you go to the in-game option, you'll be able to find the "Export" and "Import" button on the game info panel.

"Export" means that you're sending out the account info from the current platform(Platform A). "Import" means that you are receiving that info to the current platform(Platform B).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/d92d8b4cfae7a76448cb619d6139b928fd445f33.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/db89a04820c0d4cd02001c7727ffffc64d0c6ac4.png[/img]

3. On Platform A's option, please press "Export" button. The exporting code will appear. This code only lasts for a limited length of time, so before it is terminated you have to put the code on the Platform B. Let me show you how.

4. On Platform B's option, please press "Import" button. A window with the empty slot will appear. This is where you type in the Exporting code from Platform A. After you type in the code, confirm.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/d183454739a75d7b60851893f25273d075a2e1a2.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/1bce228536789e05fc13a8668610df652ed4a278.png[/img]

※ Beware: If you complete the link, the account on Platform B will be terminated. Please link your platforms with caution.

When the game says "Account link successful. The game will restart", you have completed the synchronization. Congratulations!


Synchronization Q&A

Q. Can I link all four platforms with a single account?
A. As mentioned at the beginning, YES! Here's how.
ex) I want to link all 4 platforms with my Google Android account!
- Export Google account info => Import from Apple's Iron League
- Export Google account info => Import from Steam's Iron League
- Export Google account info => Import from Facebook Iron League
In other words, you have to link platforms with different codes each time.

Q. I already linked Platform A&B by exporting info from A to B. Now I want to link Platform C to B.
A. Unfortunately, one platform can only import the account info from "one" different platform. It means that since B is already linked with A, you cannot export C's info to B.
However, you can export info as many times as you can. So, if you want to link all four platforms, you have to choose one "main" and "final" account that is going to last.

Q. Can I synchronize with my "iOS Guest" account?
A. No, you cannot. You will have to change the guest account to the official Gamecenter ID to link.

Q. I chose the wrong main account and made a mistake while linking. Can I disconnect the link?
A. Until the end of May, the Iron League support center receives the desynchronization request, only ONCE for each account.
※Desynchronization request form: https://bit.ly/2r9pn72

Right after the end of our 2.3 Patch, the synchronization will be available immediately. If you have any question or confusion feel free to contact us! Thank you.
